shots.focal_element: The 'Data analysed' presentation frame (coral text panel left, 3D render right) filling the board view in present mode
shots.typography: Slide title in a bold geometric sans, sentence case, normal tracking; bullets in bold sans, sentence case; small pill-shaped cursor name labels and a compact presentation toolbar in a light UI sans (font guess, low confidence: a Miro-style geometric sans).
shots.what_happens: The board pushes in from the previous frame (dark roadmap frame exits left) and settles on frame 3/10 'Data analysed'; Sophia's and Ashley's named cursors sit on the slide while the presentation toolbar stays docked at the bottom. VO starts 'Midway through the presentation' (w86-w89).
shots.build_rebuild: Horizontally translate a wide board canvas so the next 16:9 frame slides in from the right with an ease-out over ~0.5 s, keeping a fixed bottom-centre toolbar and two absolutely positioned named cursor pills overlaid.

shots.focal_element: The 'Choose a new presenter' handoff popover above the presentation toolbar
on_screen_text: Once you handoff, you will become an audience member without presentation controls.
shots.typography: Popover heading in bold sans, sentence case; helper text and role labels in regular grey sans, small size; names in medium weight; buttons in medium sans, sentence case. A fourth list entry (possibly 'Lisa') is mostly hidden under Ashley's cursor label and not quoted.
shots.what_happens: On a plain light-grey canvas with only the isolated toolbar, Ashley's cursor opens a participant list from the people icon, then a 'Choose a new presenter' popover appears; she moves down the list, selects Sophia (row highlights, check moves from Ashley to Sophia, 'Switch presenter' activates) and clicks it. The isolated UI then fades out and the full board fades back in. VO w90-w102 ('she can easily hand off presenting to Sophia to walk through user feedback').
shots.build_rebuild: Fade the board out to an empty background, keep only the toolbar and popover centred, script a cursor that hovers list rows (row highlight + checkmark swap) and clicks a button that changes from disabled to primary, then crossfade back to the full board.

shots.focal_element: The full Miro board UI with a row of presentation frames, and a 'Presentation' join pop-up appearing at the top right
on_screen_text: People are struggling in two main areas:
1. Battery life is reported as inconsistent
2. App syncing breaks unexpectedly during onboarding
shots.typography: Product chrome in small regular UI sans; slide titles in bold sans, sentence case; sticky-note clusters with bold coloured category labels. The join pop-up text is too small in the sheets to quote reliably (appears to read 'Presentation' and a '... is presenting' line with two buttons).
shots.what_happens: Now from a viewer's perspective, the board is shown zoomed out with Data analysed, User feedback, sticky-note clusters and chart frames; the view drifts left slightly and a 'Presentation' join pop-up appears at the top right, the cursor clicks join, and the pop-up dismisses. VO w103-w119 ('As viewers, her teammates see a join pop up when a presentation is started on the board').
shots.build_rebuild: Render the full board UI at small scale with a slow horizontal drift, then animate a small card into the top-right corner (fade + slight slide down), move a cursor onto its primary button, click, and fade the card out.

shots.focal_element: The 'Alignment and next steps' frame with four numbered blue circles, plus a thumbs-up reaction with an avatar floating up
on_screen_text: Alignment with Bluetooth team regarding overall product requirements
UXR backlog means we won't get another round of testing before next quarter
Alignment with Support and Marketing on customer response plan
shots.typography: Frame heading in bold sans, blue, sentence case; large bold numerals in solid circles; step descriptions in small centred regular sans with key nouns in bold; viewer toolbar labels ('Raise', 'Leave') in small medium sans. Part of step 1 is covered by Ashley's cursor label and is quoted only as visible fragments.
shots.what_happens: A fast pan (motion-blurred at the start) moves across the board past 'The data' and 'Risks' frames to the 'Alignment and next steps' frame; a viewer's thumbs-up reaction with avatar floats up from the bottom, Deepak's cursor appears on the right, and the viewer toolbar (Raise, reactions, Leave) is visible; at the end the view starts panning back left. VO w120-w132 ('Even if they're late to the meeting, they can still quickly get context').
shots.build_rebuild: Translate the board canvas quickly with a short directional motion blur, land on a centred frame, then spawn a thumbs-up emoji with an attached avatar that rises and fades over ~1.5 s above a bottom reaction toolbar.

shots.focal_element: The 'Data analysed' frame reached by panning back, with a 'Return to Sophia' pill above the viewer toolbar
on_screen_text: People are struggling in two main areas:
shots.typography: Same slide typography as earlier frames (bold sans titles, bold sans bullets); the 'Return to Sophia' control is a small blue pill with white medium sans text.
shots.what_happens: The viewer pans independently back across the board from User feedback/charts to the 'Data analysed' frame, while a small 'Return to Sophia' pill appears above the bottom toolbar indicating the viewer has left the presenter's view; Deepak's and Ashley's cursors move on the slides. VO w133-w147 ('by panning to the earlier parts of the board before going to the current view').
shots.build_rebuild: Ease the board canvas horizontally to the right to reveal an earlier frame and fade in a small blue 'Return to <name>' pill centred above the bottom toolbar once the view diverges from the presenter.
